entry.summary: Let $\(X\,cal(A)\,mu\)$ be a measure space, and $f_n\,g_n\,f\,g in L^1$, $n in bb(N)$. Suppose that - $lim_(n arrow.r oo) f_n\(x\)= f\(x\)$ and $lim_(n arrow.r oo) g_n\(x\)= g\(x\)$ for a.e. $x$\; - $\|f_n\(x\)\|lt.eq g_n\(x\)$ a.e. for every $n in bb(N)$\; - $g_n : X arrow.r\[0\,oo\]$ and $lim_(n arrow.r oo) integral g_n d mu = integral g d mu$. Then we have: $ lim_(n arrow.r oo) integral f_n d mu = integral f d mu $
